HomePage.heroHeading: Give as a stream, not a one-time click.
HomePage.heroSubtext: StreamGive lets you support verified NGOs on Stellar with continuous, cancel-anytime donations — transparent, on-chain, and instant.

steps.title: Connect your wallet
steps.description: Freighter or any supported Stellar wallet — one click, no account to create.

steps.title: Start a stream
steps.description: Pick a verified NGO, set an amount and a rate. They get paid continuously, second by second — not in one lump sum.

steps.title: Stay in control
steps.description: Top up, adjust the rate, or cancel anytime. Unspent funds always come back to you, instantly.
